text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...? ...Shall I turn on the air 
conditioner?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sfera. "STRK"... Neo Universe continued 
once more from that day.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And... Duramente, too. In this universe, 
right now, right beside "me," it 
continues.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wishes for... what lies 
beyond. In other words, I shall sing. To 
the stars... a 『Birthday』.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Tomorrow night, would you care to join 
me for a run around the perimeter?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I know a nice hill. The stars are crystal 
clear and easy to see from there.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Let's sing until "our" "signal" reaches 
what is "precious"... to us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes. If it will serve as a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente. "AST, M"... It really is "hot", 
isn't it? This "orbit" is—
